changeSet.sql: IF SCHEMA_ID(N'wf_test') IS NULL EXEC(N'CREATE SCHEMA wf_test');

changeSet.author: workflow-test-host
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE wf_test.management_audit ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, occurred_at DATETIME2(7) NOT NULL, actor_ref NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT NULL, operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, entity_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, entity_id BIGINT NOT NULL, correlation_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, evidence_json NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_console_audit_kind CHECK(entity_kind IN ('DEFINITION','DEFINITION_VERSION','TASK_TYPE')), CONSTRAINT ck_console_audit_id CHECK(entity_id > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_console_audit_json CHECK(ISJSON(evidence_json)=1 AND DATALENGTH(evidence_json)<=524288) );
